scope: Development Stage A only; no joint applicability or reserved confirmation claim
five_NPZ_slots: BC, current wind body, current wind legacy, control PPO, geometry PPO; wind body and legacy slots contain identical actor bytes with separately declared thrust semantics
training_integrity: Both arms must finish their fixed equal-budget paired training before any model is archived or flown; the same baseline, candidate-selection rule and training sources are hash-bound
selection_rule: Evaluate both new PPO arms over the entire fixed matrix. Do not select a convenient arm or omit cells based on Gazebo outcomes. Any later recipe selection and three-training-seed confirmation require a new prospective freeze
gates: The existing v2.1 operational gates and thesis macro coverage rules remain unchanged. Extra controls are additional prospective evidence, not altered acceptance criteria
error_rule: Retain every valid controller FAIL and continue. Independently identified infrastructure ERROR stops unstarted cases; preserve all raw attempts and a sealed exact reason before a separately reviewed exact retry. No automatic retries
limitations: One development environment and one paired training initialization. Native PID controls are shared once per profile. Absolute-time wind scheduling does not guarantee wind at each route corner. Force-mild is not covered by this Stage A matrix
